method: Viewed actual source artwork, producer masks/contact sheets, independently extracted native-resolution motion and last-two/first-two seam crops. Fully decoded all 84 frames per video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask and brightness metrics. Compared Sakura source and video blossom cluster at 3x enlargement. Verified SHA-256 before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, motion mask, producer contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples of stove fire and mug steam, and last-two/first-two seam crops. Sleeping creature, ears, face, stove door, mug, crates, terrariums and landscape remain stable.

Stove flame changes stay inside the firebox without displaced duplicate flames or movement across the creature silhouette. Mug vapor is faint and transparent in sampled frames; the cup rim and background crates remain legible.
Independent full decode of all 84 frames reproduces seam ratio 1.8301 and outside-mask change 0.000054. Boundary samples show no obvious additional geometry jump.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, motion mask, producer contact sheet, eight native-resolution samples of blossom and pond regions, and last-two/first-two seam crops. Desk, book, brush, mug, buildings, bridge, pond edges and loose desk petals retain their source geometry.

Animated blossom cluster produces persistent translucent duplicate petals and branch outlines where the generated image moves against the retained source. This is visible in native-resolution samples and confirmed by a 3x source/frame-12 comparison. The cluster looks softly doubled rather than like singular flowers swaying.

Pond ripples and reflected light vary gently without obvious hard mask boundaries. Independent full decode of all 84 frames reproduces seam ratio 1.0851 and outside-mask change 0.000150; passing technical metrics do not detect the blossom compositing defect.
requiredChanges: Disable the misaligned blossom animation while preserving the pond motion, or repair blossom compositing so each flower and branch remains singular. Re-render and independently review the new hash.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
